title: Has Oda Kogusu, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Specific Has Oda Kogusu/Dormitory of the Privy Chamber on OSM way103907804: irregular elongated footprint, pale stone rear range and short angled southern connector, open courtyard colonnade with slender grey shafts/pale capitals/pointed arches, two window rows, low lead main roof and repeated shallow polygonal portico crowns. Preserve the independent Agas Mosque and large domed Sacred Relics chambers. No copied inscriptions, visitors, garden props or furnished museum interior.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Declared Topkapi Q170495 OSM member way103907804/native35184475996636. Existing standard PMTiles fixes the full irregular parent and angled southern connector. Internal+X follows the range northeast; internal+Z faces southeast into Third Courtyard. Ordinary courtyard photographs guide the arcade. Has Oda Kogusu is the dormitory, not the adjacent Sacred Relics chamber or the Harem private rooms.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Picture-led eaves5.8m, spring3.25m and shallow portico crowns above the authored occupied floor; nine representative open bays along the mapped straight courtyard leg. Hidden rear windows, the main hipped roof, window/door inventory and exact crown profiles are approximations. No measured architectural heights; native height5 is a coarse map hint.
